build_lstm_encoder: build a bidirectional LSTM encoder with an embedding layer for sequence encoding
create_embedding_layer: create an nn.Embedding layer with a specified vocab size and embedding dimension
run_lstm_forward: run the LSTM forward pass on a batch of input sequence tensors
test_lstm_encoder: test the LSTMEncoder class by passing input tensors and verifying output shape
review_lstm_encoder_forward: review the LSTMEncoder forward method that concatenates bidirectional hidden states
